technical_and_design_decisions: Use Kafka's native consumer API for offset management to ensure compatibility and performance with existing Spring XD components.
Implement partition pre-allocation using a static assignment strategy during stream deployment to avoid rebalancing and simplify management.
Extend Spring XD's message bus with a partition allocator that coordinates with container lifecycle for crash resilience and redeployment stability.
Adopt a modular design for Spark integration to allow flexible proof-of-concept iterations and future scalability.
Utilize Project Reactor for reactive stream processing in the reactor-stream module to handle time-window operations efficiently.
Design microbatching with configurable batch intervals and asynchronous processing to enhance performance throughput without major code changes.
Set up performance testing infrastructure on Rackspace using open-source tools like JMeter for benchmarking and custom scripts for XD use-cases.
assumptions: The developer has prior experience with Spring XD, Kafka, and related frameworks, reducing learning curve overhead.
Access to the Spring XD codebase, development environment, and necessary tools (e.g., IDE, build systems) is available.
Kafka clusters and Rackspace resources are pre-provisioned or can be set up within the estimated effort for infrastructure tasks.
Documentation includes wiki content creation, formatting, and integration with existing Spring XD documentation standards.
Effort estimates are based on a standard 8-hour workday and assume no significant external delays or dependencies.
All activities are treated as independent for estimation purposes, with no parallelization adjustments needed.

activities.activity_description: Create and update wiki documentation for new sources, sinks, processor modules, and features, including configuration guides and usage examples based on user stories.
Implement feature to control starting offset of Kafka source during stream deployment, ensuring offsets survive crashes and handling undeploy/redeploy scenarios with state persistence.

activities.activity_name: Kafka Partition Pre-allocation for Source Modules
activities.activity_description: Develop pre-allocation of partitions for Kafka source modules when streams are deployed, using a static assignment strategy to simplify deployment and prevent rebalancing.
Extend Spring XD's message bus to pre-allocate partitions between nodes during stream deployment, ensuring stability during container crashes and redeployments.
Investigate Spark integration with Spring XD, develop a proof of concept for data processing, and identify optimal design and implementation approaches for future development.
Develop a new processor module using Reactor-stream to enable time-window operations on data streams, including configuration options and integration with existing source modules.
Implement microbatching capability in source modules to ingest data based on configurable batch intervals, enhancing performance throughput without disrupting existing functionality.
Set up performance testing infrastructure on Rackspace, including server provisioning, tool configuration (e.g., JMeter), and creation of benchmark scripts for Kafka and XD use-cases.
